grayscale.rationale: Removes chroma while preserving prospectively defined Rec.709 luma with lower development-sample luma error than Pillow L reference.

hand_mask.detector: MediaPipe Hand Landmarker on original full-resolution RGB frame
hand_mask.mask_recipe: Map full-resolution hand landmarks to model canvas; convex-hull seed; hull dilation=9; extend with strict skin mask within 51-pixel seed neighborhood; final dilation=5.
hand_mask.why_not_hull_only: Visual review showed the hull-only mask was more conservative and often omitted visible hand/arm extent.
hand_mask.why_not_fallback: The classical fallback increased nominal coverage but introduced less-specific masks on detector-miss cases; false-positive page/background masking is a worse confound for a hand-specific ablation than documented detector misses.

replacement.matched_control: same mask mirrored horizontally with same fill method

supersession.reason: User rejected algorithm quality before any primary-test perturbation evaluation. Development continues.
